units.source_text: 阿住最先的感受是困窘。

en.t: The first thing Osumi felt was embarrassment.

units.source_text: 学校的老师居然对自己的孙子广次说了这么大一个谎言——

en.t: A schoolteacher had actually told such a huge lie to his own grandson, Hirotsugu—

units.source_text: 事实上，阿住觉得再也没有比这件事更令人诧异的事了。

en.t: In fact, Osumi felt that nothing could be more astonishing than this.

units.source_text: 可是，在一瞬的困窘之后，阿住突然大发脾气，

en.t: But after a moment of embarrassment, Osumi suddenly flew into a rage,

units.source_text: 像是变成另一个人一样骂起了阿民。

en.t: and began scolding Otami as if she had become a different person.
